response.chief_complaint_evolution: Initial report of sudden severe pain and swelling in the right big toe joint overnight, causing extreme sensitivity to touch (unable to bear a bedsheet touching it).

key_findings_timeline.finding: Sudden severe pain and swelling of the right big toe joint overnight, cannot bear the bedsheet touching it.

response.end_state_clinical_picture: Patient presents with acute reported monoarthritis of the right first metatarsophalangeal joint (classic presentation for podagra/gout). No objective physical exam findings, lab results, or imaging have been completed in this initial note.
response.pending_vs_confirmed: Confirmed: Patient-reported symptoms of acute right big toe pain, swelling, and severe touch sensitivity. Pending: Clinical examination, laboratory workup (e.g., serum uric acid, inflammatory markers), joint aspiration/synovial fluid analysis, and imaging.
